claim_checks.claim: Shares traded in USD on LSE since 1-Apr-2026 (not Jan-2026)
claim_checks.finding: RNS 1-Apr-2026 confirms trading currency changed from GBp to USD with effect from 1 April 2026 (further to 18-Mar-2026 announcement). FTSE inclusion and LSE listing unaffected; dividends paid in GBP unless USD elected. Reporting currency USD since FY2024.

Profit is disclosed by region only: North America underlying operating profit $2,582m of $3,335m group (77.4% of group incl. central costs; 74.1% of regional profit $3,486m) at 8.2% margin vs International $904m at 6.1%. US-only profit not disclosed. US = 64.8% of underlying revenue (derived from note 2).

claim_checks.claim: Net new business in 4-5% range (FY25 4.5%, FY24 4.2%)
claim_checks.finding: FY25 4.5% (fourth consecutive year in range), FY24 4.2%. Note H1 FY26 NNB was 3.8% (below range); company said it accelerated into range in Q3 and expects a fifth year in range. Pre-pandemic NNB ~3%.

Not quantified in any FY25/H1/Q3 FY26 release. Qualitative only: FY23 margin progress 'despite mobilisation costs associated with new business growth'; Q3 FY26 capex (3.5% YTD) to be 'slightly elevated at full year due to the timing of client mobilisations'.

claim_checks.finding: Not yet published as of 2026-11-12: Q3 trading update gives full-year results date 24 November 2026. FY2027 guidance therefore not available (null).
